description: This file defines a factory class for creating MySQL database connections, utilizing configuration options provided via dependency injection. It implements an interface for creating connections and provides methods for parsing URL configurations to extract connection parameters.

classes.name: IMySqlConnectionFactory
classes.description: Interface defining a method for creating IDbConnection instances.

classes.name: MySqlConnectionFactory
classes.description: Sealed class implementing connection creation for MySQL, parsing URL options, and configurable via dependency injection.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a new IDbConnection to MySQL database based on environment configurations.

methods.name: TryParsePort
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into an integer port number, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: ParseMysqlUrl
methods.description: Parses a MySQL URL string to extract host, port, and database name components.
